caseDiagnosis.cpf-04: Existing AW PDF was sufficient. Incidental IRAS bonus routing and the performance year incorrectly displaced the contractual payable-year scope. The answer uses 2026 without inventing a contribution amount or performance year.
caseDiagnosis.cpf-06: Existing PR-year method alone did not establish conversion-month OW proration. Added official CPF Board PR wage-boundary evidence; corrected grant-date ownership and source admission. Anniversary dates and conversion-month proration are derived generically from established employee facts.
caseDiagnosis.cpf-07: Existing AW definition did not establish foreign-to-PR payable-date treatment. Added official before/after-grant AW evidence. The stated before/after relationship can be answered without inventing an exact grant date or contribution amount.
caseDiagnosis.fresh31-cpf-01: Existing OW/AW premises were sufficient. Factual payable dates were mistaken for legal date scope and employee facts were not independently applied. Each employee now uses their own employment month and payable date; missing dates remain unresolved.
caseDiagnosis.fresh31-cpf-02: Existing OW/AW ceiling evidence was sufficient, but topic/title admission and OW/AW amount binding prevented a complete answer. Monthly OW capping is separate from annual AW headroom, and a preceding bonus amount cannot be borrowed as OW.
